home.about.heading: Rustic Wooden Warmth Meets Lively Patio Evenings
home.about.body: True to its name—meaning 'dusk' or 'evening'—Saanjh was built as Viman Nagar's neighborhood gathering table. Whether you are bringing three generations of family for rich biryanis and Maharashtrian specialties, or meeting friends on the green outdoor patio for mushroom crostinis and botanical cocktails, every table is lit with warm amber hospitality. Enjoy complimentary valet parking and full wheelchair accessibility.

about.header.heading: An Evening Full Of Flavours
about.story.heading: Designed for Multi-Generational Gatherings
about.story.body_1: Located in Clover Park just opposite Phoenix Marketcity, Saanjh blends earthy wooden textures, soft amber lighting, and a breezy green outdoor setup. It is a place where grandparents, parents, and friends feel equally at home.
about.story.body_2: With air-conditioned indoor seating, a lively outdoor patio, a newly opened bar section, valet parking, and full wheelchair-accessible step-free entry, every detail is crafted for effortless dining.
about.chef.name: Eclectic Flavours, Rooted in Craft
about.chef.bio: Our kitchen bridges bold regional Maharashtrian spices, slow-cooked Dum Biryanis, wood-fired Italian pizzas, Asian wok favourites, and Continental small plates like our signature Mushroom Crostinis—paired with handcrafted cocktails and zero-proof botanical mocktails.
